title: Technical advisory committee.
bodyText: The commissioner shall appoint an advisory committee of persons having expertise and familiarity relevant to the mitigation grant program and feasibility study report.
bodyHtml: [§431:22-105]  Technical advisory committee.  The commissioner shall appoint an advisory committee of persons having expertise and familiarity relevant to the mitigation grant program and feasibility study report. [L 2002, c 179, pt of §3]
